status: FINAL - locked by the owner on 2026-11-06. Do not change any of this without the owner's explicit OK.
reference_sheet: concept/FINAL_characters.png (source: concept/teens_sheet.py, style switches SH_STYLE='base', GB_STYLE='base')
style: 2D comic look: bold dark ink outlines (#1b1418, ~4.5px at sheet scale), flat colours, halftone-dot shadows (gabby_sheet.HALFTONE=True), light from the upper left, organic hands (4 fingers + thumb, nails, lighter palms).

shirley.role: elder sister, ~16, the sensible one; a modern Indian teen girl who likes fitted modern clothes
shirley.face: oval, tapering to a small soft chin; kept short top-to-bottom; small gap between nose and mouth; almond eyes with big dark-brown irises and natural lashes; soft thin brows; small nose; small closed smile; faint blush
shirley.hair: black short bob to the jaw with a wispy pointed fringe down to the brows, bob side panels over the cheeks, small ears peeking; green 5-petal flower hair clip on her right (screen-left) side; blue-grey shine arc
shirley.outfit: fitted lilac zip hoodie, hood down behind the neck, half-zipped over a white tee with a little planet print, white drawstrings, ribbed cuffs and hip-length ribbed hem; slim blue jeans; white sneakers; gold bangle on the relaxed wrist
shirley.default_pose: standing, one arm relaxed, other hand (fist) on hip

gabby.role: younger brother, ~14, gymnastics/fitness freak; loud, bouncy, optimistic, gullible; can't pass a wall without a handstand
gabby.face: round like the reference but LEAN: widest at the eyes, clean taper to the chin, no puffy cheeks; fairly narrow; short top-to-bottom; small nose-to-mouth gap; prominent ears; almond eyes that squint up when he grins; small broad nose; wide smile showing the upper teeth with small dimples
gabby.skin: a little fairer than Shirley (not too fair)
gabby.hair: thick short wavy black hair with a wavy fringe edge and short sideburns, blue-grey shine curls
gabby.outfit: red hoodie, hood down behind the neck, white drawstrings, kangaroo pocket, ribbed hem, sleeves pushed up to the elbows; frayed light-denim shorts with chalk handprints; white wrist tape; chalky hands; plaster on one knee; white sneakers with red soles and white socks
signature_poses: gymnast 'ta-da' salute (arms up in a V, open palms, chalk puffs)

privacy: This repo is public: never commit the owner's personal reference photos or say whose likeness the designs are based on.
